description.value: The Revelstoke Railway Museum preserves and interprets the history of the Canadian Pacific Railway through the mountains of Western Canada, a story central to the formation of Canada as a nation. Visitors can operate a diesel locomotive simulator using a real control stand, walk through an outdoor Heritage Railcar collection adjacent to a park on museum grounds, and explore multiple galleries tracing the people and machines of Canadian railways. For touring cyclists passing through Revelstoke on Trans-Canada or Rogers Pass routes, this is a well-established cultural landmark with an active events calendar.
